subject: general
question: According to the Indian Constitution, a member of the Union Public Service Commission holds office for a term of six years or till he attains the age of __________ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**65.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• According to the Indian Constitution, a member of the Union Public Service Commission holds office for a term of six years or till he attains **the age of 65 years.**
 
• Union Public Service Commission is the Central Recruitment Agency of India.
 
 
• The Union Public Service Commission is described in Part 14 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It deals with Articles 315 to 323.
 
• It is a constitutional and autonomous body.
 
• It works under the Ministry of Personnel. ** **
 
• It was first formed in 1926 on the recommendation of the **Lee Commission. **
 
• The Public Commission was established on 26 October 1950 under constitutional provisions.
